rationale: Pad the private SDL heap header to max_align_t alignment; preserve original m68k four-byte header and serialized formats. A four-byte offset from malloc violates the fundamental alignment of 64-bit payloads.
verification: Production host allocator RED22 -> GREEN0 for zero/small/large allocations, NULL realloc, grow/shrink alignment and exact payload preservation. Full v11 game and separate native allocator probe compile; native runtime pending.
target: portable SDL allocators; original m68k header layout retained
